description: Where the current FDA labels of menopause hormone therapy stand on the boxed warning FDA asked makers to change on 10 Nov 2025, as FDA's label database (openFDA) reads today: per treatment, how many makers' labels carry the updated (endometrial-only) warning, none, or the full warning with cardiovascular and dementia language, and each label's brand, maker, route and date.
